name: Pallof Press

instructions.description: Stand sideways to a resistance band anchor and hold the band at chest height with both hands.
Step away from the anchor to create tension and adopt a stable athletic stance.
Press the hands straight forward without letting the trunk rotate toward the anchor.
Bring the hands back to the chest with control and repeat before switching sides.

performanceMetrics.notes: Anti-rotation control is the priority rather than maximal band tension.

variations.variationDescription: Another anti-lateral and anti-rotation trunk exercise performed in standing.

variationSuggestions.variationDescription: Kneel to reduce lower-limb compensation and emphasize trunk control.

commentsNotes: Do not let the ribs flare as the arms extend.
